<item rdf:about="https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260912">
  <title>Updated Debian 13: 13.7 released</title>
  <link>https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260912</link>
  <description>
    The Debian project is pleased to announce the seventh update of its
stable distribution Debian 13 (codename <q>trixie</q>).
This point release mainly adds corrections for security issues,
along with a few adjustments for serious problems. Security advisories
have already been published separately and are referenced where available.
  </description>
  <dc:date>2026-09-12</dc:date>
</item>
<item rdf:about="https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260831">
  <title>Debian 11 Long Term Support reaches end-of-life</title>
  <link>https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260831</link>
  <description>
The Debian Long Term Support (LTS) Team hereby announces that Debian 11
<q>bullseye</q> support has reached its end-of-life today, 31 August 2026,
five years after its initial release on 14 August 2021.
  </description>
  <dc:date>2026-08-31</dc:date>
</item>
<item rdf:about="https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260807">
  <title>DebConf26 closes in Santa Fe and DebConf27 announced</title>
  <link>https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260807</link>
  <description>
On Saturday 25 July 2026, the annual
<a href="https://debconf26.debconf.org/">Debian Developers and Contributors Conference</a>
came to a close.
  </description>
  <dc:date>2026-08-07</dc:date>
</item>
<item rdf:about="https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260712">
  <title>Security support for Bookworm handed over to the LTS team</title>
  <link>https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260712</link>
  <description>
On 12 July 2026, three years after the initial release, the regular
support for Debian 12, alias <q>bookworm</q>, has come to an end. The
Debian <a href="https://wiki.debian.org/LTS/">Long Term Support (LTS)</a> Team
is taking over security support from the Security and Release Teams.
  </description>
  <dc:date>2026-07-12</dc:date>
</item>
<item rdf:about="https://www.debian.org/News/2026/2026071102">
  <title>Updated Debian 12: 12.15 released</title>
  <link>https://www.debian.org/News/2026/2026071102</link>
  <description>
    The Debian project is pleased to announce the fifteenth and final update of its
oldstable distribution Debian 12 (codename <q>bookworm</q>).
This point release mainly adds corrections for security issues,
along with a few adjustments for serious problems. Security advisories
have already been published separately and are referenced where available.
  </description>
  <dc:date>2026-07-11</dc:date>
</item>
<item rdf:about="https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260711">
  <title>Updated Debian 13: 13.6 released</title>
  <link>https://www.debian.org/News/2026/20260711</link>
  <description>
    The Debian project is pleased to announce the sixth update of its
stable distribution Debian 13 (codename <q>trixie</q>).
This point release mainly adds corrections for security issues,
along with a few adjustments for serious problems. Security advisories
have already been published separately and are referenced where available.
  </description>
  <dc:date>2026-07-11</dc:date>
</item>
